title: Bridge theme
description: A bright, airy fintech light theme: white page, near-black ink, one sky blue for the bar, buttons and label squares, seafoam as the second colour, quiet mid-grey secondary text and #eee hairlines. A neutral grotesk in regular weight only, a light mono for labels, almost-square corners. A near-black navy dark sibling.
notes: Hanken Grotesk stands in for ABC Diatype, DM Mono for Diatype Mono
